title: Puppy wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='22' ry='17' fill='#c8792f'/>
  <!-- chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#f0c88a'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='82' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#c8792f'/>
  <rect x='57' y='82' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#c8792f'/>
  <ellipse cx='39.5' cy='95' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#f0c88a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60.5' cy='95' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#f0c88a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='21' fill='#c8792f'/>
  <!-- floppy ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='46' rx='8' ry='15' fill='#a35f24' transform='rotate(12 30 46)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='46' rx='8' ry='15' fill='#a35f24' transform='rotate(-12 70 46)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#f0c88a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='3' fill='#2a1633'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='42' r='3' fill='#2a1633'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='41' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='41' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2a1633'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 53 q-4 4 -7 2' stroke='#2a1633' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 53 q4 4 7 2' stroke='#2a1633' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#e0556e'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M50 6 L38 30 L62 30 Z' fill='#2fbf9f'/>
  <path d='M50 6 L38 30 L62 30 Z' fill='none'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <path d='M44 20 L56 20' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='3.5'/>
  <path d='M41 26 L59 26' stroke='#ff7ba8' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- hat pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='4' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- hat trim -->
  <rect x='37' y='28' width='26' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff7ba8'/>
</svg>
